summary: OpenAI published a Q1 2026 update describing broadened ChatGPT adoption across older users and more balanced gender usage.

mechanisms.reason: Broader mainstream adoption of ChatGPT implies more users and likely more inference volume, though the summary gives no scale detail.
mechanisms.quote: ChatGPT adoption surged in Q1 2026, with fastest growth among users over 35 and more balanced gender usage, signaling broader mainstream AI adoption.
